beats.say: You might think cinema classics hold every top spot, but the truth is actually quite different.
At number five is Titanic, released in 1997, earning 2,257,906,828 dollars at the global box office.
Number four is Avatar: The Way of Water from 2022, with 2,334,484,620 dollars in total earnings.

shots.src: commons-search:Avatar The Way of Water poster

beats.say: In third place, Spider-Man: Brand New Day hit cinemas in 2026, grossing 2,517,281,128 dollars.
Taking the second spot is the original Avatar from 2009, with 2,923,710,708 dollars.
And at number one, Avengers: Endgame stands alone with a massive 2,941,390,588 dollars worldwide.
Modern blockbusters clearly dominate the list, but which of these have you actually seen in the cinema?

facts: Avengers: Endgame is ranked number 1 with a worldwide gross of $2,941,390,588 in 2019.
Avatar is ranked number 2 with a worldwide gross of $2,923,710,708 in 2009.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day is ranked number 3 with a worldwide gross of $2,517,281,128 in 2026.
Avatar: The Way of Water is ranked number 4 with a worldwide gross of $2,334,484,620 in 2022.
Titanic is ranked number 5 with a worldwide gross of $2,257,906,828 in 1997.
